name: Post Matric Scholarship to OBC Students (Maharashtra)
provider: VJNT, OBC and SBC Welfare Department, Government of Maharashtra (via MahaDBT)

rules.quote: The parents/Guardians annual Income should be less than or equal to Rs.2.50 Lac.
Applicant should be belongs to OBC category.
Applicants must be residents of Maharashtra.
Applicants must be pursuing the education course approved by the government from class Post-Matric.

rules.value: CAP round admission required for professional courses
rules.quote: Applicant should be come through CAP round for only professional courses.

rules.value: 75% attendance; max 2 boys per family, any number of girls
rules.quote: 75 % attendance is mandatory for current year.

amount.text: Maintenance allowance Rs 90-425 per month by course group (hosteller/day scholar); tuition and exam fee 100% in govt/aided, 50% in unaided institutions; 100% benefit for girls per GR 8 July 2024
amount.quote: If Applicant select Course Group A - for hostlers Rs.425/p.m. & Day Scholars(Non Hostlers) Rs.190/p.m.
amount.quote2: As per the GR dt.8 ’th July 2024, 100 % benefit will be applicable for girl Applicant.

documents.name: Caste certificate (Govt of Maharashtra)
documents.quote: Caste certificate - should be issued by competent authority(Issued by Govt. of Maharashtra)

documents.name: Income certificate / declaration
documents.quote: Income certificate / Income Declaration - should be issued by competent authority

documents.name: Caste validity certificate (professional courses)
documents.quote: Caste Validity Certificate – (Mandatory for Professional Degree courses, Professional Post Graduate.

documents.name: Last exam / HSC / SSC marksheet
documents.quote: HSC or SSC marksheet or last examination marksheet.

deadline.text: MahaDBT 1.0 open for AY 2025-26 fresh applications; AY 2026-27 applications only via MahaDBT 2.0 (mahadbt2.maharashtra.gov.in)
deadline.quote: Fresh and renewal applications for the Academic Year 2026-27 will be accepted only through the MahaDBT 2.0 Portal.
